strongest_angle: Break down the mechanical restraint upgrades announced by Six Flags CEO John Reilly following the October 2026 fatal incident involving 42-year-old Hassan Kariem on the Goliath hyper coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia.

key_facts.fact: Six Flags CEO John Reilly announced in an October 23, 2026 letter that the company will add seatbelts to the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia after a fatal fall earlier that month.
The October 2026 fatal incident at Six Flags Over Georgia involved 42-year-old rider Hassan Kariem, who fell to his death from the Goliath hyper coaster.
Following the October 2026 accident on Goliath at Six Flags Over Georgia, the theme park operator decided to install safety seatbelts across other company rides featuring similar restraints.
